An investigation into the failing tests revealed a `NullPointerException` thrown in [`XYPlot.getDataRange(ValueAxis)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_a_blind/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4493).

### Root Cause
When calculating axis bounds in `XYPlot.getDataRange(ValueAxis axis)`, the renderer `r` associated with dataset `d` (`XYItemRenderer r = getRendererForDataset(d);`) can be `null` (such as when an [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_a_blind/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L645) is initialized or constructed without a renderer). ### Fix
